Hi Lisa — appreciate the clear list. Draft response below (happy to iterate). I also attached our short bench notes that summarize recent quantization experiments on retrieval-heavy workloads.

Quick pilot sketch (3 months, focused on batch/cache + quantized variant):
- Pilot scope: up to 250M generated tokens (incl. eval prompts). Includes access to: hosted quantized model variant, KV-prefetch caching, and initial batching config support from our infra team.
- Credits & pricing: we propose 10,000 USD in pilot credits (applied to token consumption) + usage billed at a converted rate of ~$0.004/token for standard model variants and ~$0.0025/token for the 4-bit quantized variant during the pilot (quantized pricing is a temporary pilot rate).
- Setup fee: waived for pilots; engineering onboarding = two 90-min workshop sessions.
- Expected savings guidance (empirical): with prefix/KV caching + batching tuned to your latency SLOs, most retrieval-heavy workloads see 25–40% token-equivalent cost reductions. Adding our 4-bit quantized runtime can reduce runtime cost by another ~30–45% depending on prompt complexity and hallucination sensitivity. Typical tradeoff: 0.5–2% BLEU/semantic metric delta in our internal tests for 4-bit quant vs fp16 on retrieval-heavy prompts; 8-bit is often a safer middle ground with ~15–25% runtime improvement and <0.5% quality delta.
- Ops constraints & assumptions:
  * Max continuous batch size we recommend: 32–64 per GPU for latency-sensitive paths (we can bump for async batch paths).
  * KV-cache warmup: expect 50–200 warmup requests depending on session diversity; prefix caching reduces cold-starts during steady sessions.
  * Failover: we recommend a fallback to standard variant when latency spiking or accuracy-sensitive calls are detected.

Commit ask to unlock pilot commercial flexibility: signature on a short pilot SOW + a credit card/PO on file. We can provide a 20% discount on post-pilot committed pricing if you sign an exploration-to-production MOU within 30 days after pilot close.

Next steps: I can convert this into the RFI spreadsheet and drop in a cost table by EOD Friday. Would you like us to include an explicit quality delta table for a handful of your sample prompts?

Best,
David Kim
